propositions: Tolerant Pydantic parsing can normalize structurally divergent provider/model responses to empty results that are incorrectly treated as valid review outcomes.
Semantically empty verification results (raw-empty or malformed-to-empty after reshape) must never produce a valid pass or empty review, already enforced by pass3_decide's no-verification rule.

Telemetry must distinguish four outcome buckets (clean, recovered, empty_outcomes, unrecoverable) to differentiate provider-sent-nothing from provider-sent-garbage, shipped in verify_findings but not yet wired into live plan_review_decide and code_review_decide pipelines.
Recoverable non-empty responses from supported provider/model variations should normalize and be accepted, while maintaining provider-independent and deterministic orchestration.
Empty-after-recovery and unrecoverable responses must produce explicit indeterminate or contract-failure outcomes routed through the same no-verification decision layer.
